reviews.review:
I tried this game when it first came out, I hated it. It's poor developed crap that lives solely on "hey it's like L4D" hype. 

The game is hollow, boring, and just disgustingly bad. Do not touch this game, it's a total waste of money. I came back after a long time to see if it improved, it's still literal garbage.

It's one of the most bare bones games on steam, and while Early Access is sometimes amazing this is an example of how it's used to bs people to get their money.

June 2026: It is now, something I believe we can safely call abandonware. Hasn't been touched by an update in over a year and is just a hollow and bad experience. 

According to a quick search the last update was 15.5 months ago. Any future updates would be shocking, and would have to be massive to even matter.(not that you should expect any)

My group accepted the risk of playing an early access game, but that was largely due to the potential we saw and the fun we were able to have now. With the recent switch to peer-to-peer connections, a new class of bugs were unlocked. We endured the dry spell of any substantial changes to the game, but this server change seems to have killed any interest we had in playing it.

I received this game for free, and have logged roughly 3 hours overall. It's not a complete rip-off of Left 4 Dead...but it's close. Even so, I had fun, and can recommend it as a lighthearted, '60s themed, space zombie apocalypse, teamwork heavy, fps shooter...for anyone who's in the market for exactly that. It's not something I'd pay $30 for, so maybe wait for a sale; but it's certainly receiving harsher reviews than I think it deserves. The graphics are great, the gameplay is fun, and it's perfect for when you want to play Something, but you're not sure What. The bare bones structure of the early access still manages to be entertaining, but leaves a lot to be desired. I have a feeling that when this game is fully developed, it'll be a blast.
